name: smwmusic-law-order-mushroom-kingdom-unit-pumped-up-on-detached-cliffs
title: Law & Order: Mushroom Kingdom Unit - Pumped Up On Detached Cliffs
description:
As heard in Super Mario World Challenges, intended for ChaseNScooter's "Law & Order: Mushroom Kingdom Unit". One of the very few SMW custom songs to feature actual lyrics. Most definitely will fit bar/pub areas, or can be background noise for very abstract levels. Maaaybe Bonus Levels too.

Incompatible with Thunder/Blarggs, Yoshi, P-switch, Stage Clear, and Bonus End.
Tempo shouldn't change.
